motion_and_accessibility.motion: Minimalist. Hover states (-translate-y-[1px], subtle shadow), smooth opacity transitions. Marquee for tagline only.
motion_and_accessibility.accessibility: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text. Use APCA contrast. Support prefers-reduced-motion.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT center align the app container. Text must flow naturally (left-aligned).
DO NOT use generic AI emoji characters.
All interactive elements and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
Do NOT use HTML native date pickers or selects. Use Shadcn calendar/dropdowns if applicable, else style them meticulously.
CRITICAL: NO transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, modals, or sticky headers.
Bridge artful presentation with reliable UX for transaction/approval workflows.
Use solid backgrounds instead of glassmorphism to prevent visual refraction of financial data.
Ensure the tag line 'Solusi cerdas menuju pembiayaan berkelanjutan' runs elegantly at login/dashboard.
Color Usage: Use #00A0A0 (Primary) selectively for actions, avoid splashing it everywhere. Let the whitespace breathe.
Only generate guidelines and structures for .js files as .tsx files are not used.
